paragraphs.text: Real-time voice input and spoken answer summaries for DeepSeek Harness.
Talk to your coding agent, see your words appear in real time, and hear a concise spoken summary whe
n the work is done. Powered by AllModels.io.
Restart DeepSeek Harness, then open **Settings → Speech**.
Enter your email address and AllModels will send you a sign-in code. New accounts get **$1 free cred
it**, which should last for plenty of hours of transcription and spoken summaries.
Already have an AllModels API key? You can use that instead.
Click the microphone next to Send and start talking. Your transcript appears as you speak, ready to
rophone next to Send and start talking. Your transcript appears as you speak, ready to edit or send.
When the agent finishes, the plugin turns its final message into a short spoken summary. Enable auto
play to hear it immediately, or play it whenever you want.

- DeepSeek Harness web profile `0.1.5-rc.2`
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- Local DeepSeek Harnes
